description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corsair Captain, adding {C}{C}.
Corsair Captain dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Corsair Captain from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Corsair Captain enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any color.
Repeat.
